findings.text: The company was incorporated on 27 October 1987 and its status is recorded as dissolved, with cessation on 22 December 2025.

The accounts were last made up to 31 December 2023 and the confirmation statement was last made up to 5 March 2025; their overdue status is unknown and next due dates are not recorded.
PERSON 268 has 11 other appointments, of which 8 are active, 2 dissolved and 1 in liquidation.
No charges are registered against the company.
No registered office address changes and no officer appointments or resignations have been filed since 24 October 2025.
